boundary_reference.boundary_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0

district_boundaries.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0

district_elevation.source: Open-Meteo elevation API / Copernicus DEM GLO-90
district_elevation.method: DEM sample at each polygon representative point; not a district mean or floodplain model.

osm_features.method: Query district bounding box; count unique road/waterway ways and amenity features whose OSM node or way centre lies inside the district polygon.

daily_rainfall.source: India Meteorological Department gridded daily rainfall (0.25 degree)
daily_rainfall.licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
daily_rainfall.method: unweighted mean of valid grid-cell-centre values inside each district polygon; if covered cells contain no valid data in a file, average valid values among the eight nearest grid centres to its representative point

ranking_inputs.current_use: active; forecast percentile and analogue rainfall features
ranking_inputs.meaning: forecast rainfall intensity/duration with observed-rainfall event analogues
limitations: Archived operational forecast validation is pending.
Observed rainfall reconstruction is not forecast skill.

ranking_inputs.current_use: active; inverse rank of one representative-point elevation per district
ranking_inputs.meaning: relative elevation at a single point from Copernicus DEM GLO-90 via Open-Meteo
limitations: Not district mean elevation, local floodplain elevation, drainage, or inundation depth.
Spatial support is one representative point per district.

ranking_inputs.meaning: relative resident population total by current district polygon
limitations: Not event-time population, exposed population, or a flood footprint intersection.
The layer metadata does not record a data licence.

ranking_inputs.current_use: active; OSM hospitals/clinics/schools contribute 25% of vulnerability rank when full coverage exists
ranking_inputs.meaning: count of mapped amenities assigned by the current Overpass geometry method
limitations: OSM completeness and tagging are uneven; counts are not authoritative service capacity.
The layer records retrieval time and ODbL, but not a per-feature quality score.

ranking_inputs.current_use: active; inverse rank of OSM road ways per 100 km2
ranking_inputs.meaning: mapped road-way density, not road length or network connectivity
limitations: Does not establish passability, flood closure, travel time, or access to a particular facility.
OSM coverage is incomplete and uneven.

candidate_signals.why_existing_waterway_counts_are_not_a_s: District counts of mapped waterway ways do not provide distance to a river, stream order, floodplain, or upstream catchment.

candidate_signals.why: No drainage network, culvert capacity, or stormwater-system layer is present.
The one NRSC/ISRO extent is preliminary and ungrounded; there is no repeated, event-aligned inundation raster series.
Static mapped road density cannot represent event-time closures, surface condition, or network travel time.
No dated cropland/land-cover layer intersected with event inundation or rainfall footprints is present.

independent_added_value.reason: Existing population, elevation, and OSM proxies currently enter the ranking, but no independent event-holdout ablation establishes their incremental value. The impact labels are sparse and mostly report-derived.
independent_added_value.required_evaluation: Compare the locked baseline against one added signal at a time with the same chronological held-out events, metrics, and sample; report per-event deltas and uncertainty before enabling any new signal.
